description: ClustalW 2.1's multiple alignment of DNA (clustalw -TYPE=DNA -ALIGN) or PROTEIN (type='protein', clustalw -TYPE=PROTEIN -ALIGN), ported step by step and verified row-for-row against the installed clustalw 2.1 (1 000 DNA sets and 1 000 protein sets, option variants included): pairwise distances (distance='clustalw' = the full affine Smith-Waterman-Gotoh stage, 'clustalw-quick' = the fast k-tuple stage of -QUICKTREE with ktuple / window / topDiagonals / pairGap), ClustalW's neighbour-joining guide tree (rooted by Tree::reRoot), sequence weights derived from the tree branch lengths (Thompson, Higgins & Gibson 1994; noWeights = equal weights), delayed divergent sequences (maxDiv, default 30: sequences with at most that percent identity to every other sequence are aligned last), and profile-profile alignment with position-specific gap penalties (positions that already hold gaps get a reduced opening penalty and half the extension penalty, end gaps are free) and Myers-Miller linear-space alignment. DNA: the IUB weight matrix shifted to non-negative scores (negative = keep it signed) with transitions weighted by transitionWeight (clustalw -TRANSWEIGHT, default 0.5); gapOpen / gapExtend = -GAPOPEN 15 / -GAPEXT 6.66. PROTEIN: the matrix series of ClustalW's profile stage (matrix = -MATRIX gonnet (default) / blosum / pam / id; the table of the series is chosen per profile pair by its percent identity, e.g. GONNET80 / 250 / 120 / 350 / 160, BLOSUM80 / 62 / 45 / 30, PAM20 / 60 / 120 / 350), a gap opening scaled by the matrix average score and the logarithm of the profile lengths (gapOpen / gapExtend = -GAPOPEN 10 / -GAPEXT 0.2), the residue-specific gap penalties of Pascarella & Argos 1992 (noPreferredGaps = -NOPGAP), the hydrophilic-run penalties (noHydrophilicGaps = -NOHGAP; hydrophilicResidues = -HGAPRESIDUES, default GPSNDQEKR, at most 9 letters), the variable-region penalties (variableRegionGaps = clustalw's -NOVGAP, sic: it switches them ON), the gap-separation distance (gapDist = -GAPDIST, default 4; 0 = off) and the pairwise stage of F62 (pwMatrix = -PWMATRIX gonnet / blosum / pam / id, pwGapOpen 10 / pwGapExtend 0.1, ktuple 1-2). Known residual: with variableRegionGaps and a two-sequence profile of more than 60 % identity ClustalW reads an uninitialised C++ member (gdist), so on ~0.2 % of such runs the heap decides; the port emulates the usual value. Rows are returned in input order. match / mismatch / scoreGapOpen / scoreGapExtend (DNA) or scoreMatrix / scoreGapOpen / scoreGapExtend (protein; default BLOSUM62, open -9.8, extend -0.2) define only the reported totalScore (natural affine sum of pairs, Altschul 1989).

sequences.description: Sequences to align (at least one): DNA (A, C, G, T / IUB codes) by default, amino acids (letters A-Z except J) with type='protein'.

gapOpen.description: ClustalW -GAPOPEN: gap-opening penalty of the profile alignment (default 15 for DNA, 10 for protein; a penalty, positive).

gapExtend.description: ClustalW -GAPEXT: gap-extension penalty of the profile alignment (default 6.66 for DNA, 0.2 for protein).

distance.description: Pairwise stage that gives the guide-tree distances: 'clustalw' (default; full DP, clustalw -ALIGN) or 'clustalw-quick' (fast k-tuple mode, clustalw -QUICKTREE).

pwGapOpen.description: ClustalW -PWGAPOPEN: pairwise gap-opening penalty of the full pairwise stage (default 15 for DNA, 10 for protein).

pwGapExtend.description: ClustalW -PWGAPEXT: pairwise gap-extension penalty of the full pairwise stage (default 6.66 for DNA, 0.1 for protein).

transitionWeight.description: DNA only, ClustalW -TRANSWEIGHT: weight of transitions (A-G, C-T/U) in the profile matrix (default 0.5; 0 = as mismatches, 1 = as matches).

maxDiv.description: ClustalW -MAXDIV (default 30): a sequence whose highest percent identity to any other sequence is at most this value is delayed (aligned last, after the rest).

negative.description: ClustalW -NEGATIVE: keep the substitution matrix signed instead of shifting it to non-negative scores (protein: one matrix BLOSUM40 / PAM120 / GONNET250 instead of the series).

ktuple.description: distance='clustalw-quick' only: k-tuple (word) size, 1-4 for DNA (clustalw -KTUPLE, default 2), 1-2 for protein (default 1).

window.description: distance='clustalw-quick' only: diagonals scanned around each top diagonal (clustalw -WINDOW, default 4 for DNA, 5 for protein).

topDiagonals.description: distance='clustalw-quick' only: number of best diagonals used (clustalw -TOPDIAGS, default 4 for DNA, 5 for protein).

pairGap.description: distance='clustalw-quick' only: gap penalty of the fragment chain (clustalw -PAIRGAP; DNA default 5, or ktuple + 4 when ktuple is given; protein default 3, or ktuple + 3, as the clustalw command line does).

match.description: Score for matching base in the reported totalScore only (DNA).

mismatch.description: Score for mismatching base in the reported totalScore only (DNA).

scoreGapOpen.description: Gap-open score of the reported totalScore only (negative = penalty; default -2 for DNA, -9.8 for protein).

scoreGapExtend.description: Gap-extend score of the reported totalScore only (negative = penalty; default -1 for DNA, -0.2 for protein).

matrix.description: type='protein': ClustalW -MATRIX, the matrix series of the profile alignment: 'gonnet' (default), 'blosum', 'pam' or 'id'.

pwMatrix.description: type='protein': ClustalW -PWMATRIX, the pairwise matrix: 'gonnet' (default; GONNET250), 'blosum' (BLOSUM30), 'pam' (PAM350) or 'id'.

noPreferredGaps.description: type='protein': ClustalW -NOPGAP: switch off the residue-specific (Pascarella & Argos) gap penalties.

noHydrophilicGaps.description: type='protein': ClustalW -NOHGAP: switch off the hydrophilic-run gap penalties.

variableRegionGaps.description: type='protein': ClustalW -NOVGAP (sic): switch the variable-region gap penalties on (clustalw's default is off).

gapDist.description: type='protein': ClustalW -GAPDIST: gap separation distance (default 4; 0 = off): columns this close to an existing gap get a higher opening penalty.

hydrophilicResidues.description: type='protein': ClustalW -HGAPRESIDUES: residues of a hydrophilic stretch (default GPSNDQEKR; at most the first 9 letters are used).

scoreMatrix.description: type='protein': substitution matrix of the reported totalScore only: BLOSUM62 (default) or PAM250.

alignedSequences.description: The aligned rows of the MSA (input order).

consensus.description: Majority-vote consensus of the aligned rows (gaps vote; a nucleotide beats a gap on ties).

totalScore.description: Natural affine sum-of-pairs score of the alignment under match / mismatch / scoreGapOpen / scoreGapExtend (ClustalW itself reports no such score).

errors.message: Invalid DNA at sequences[i] (type=dna); residue not in A-Z except J (type=protein)

gapOpen, gapExtend, pwGapOpen, pwGapExtend, transitionWeight must be non-negative; distance must be clustalw or clustalw-quick; type must be dna or protein; matrix / pwMatrix / scoreMatrix must be a known name
